command: bash -lc 'set -e; cd /inspire/hdd/project/multimodal-diffusion-language-model/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/DiffRWKV-RELAY/scale; export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; CKPT=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/outputs_birwkv_diffusion/convert-2p9b-bidir/step_00004000; MDIR=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/models/RWKV7-Goose-World3-2.9B-HF; TDIRS=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/preprocessed_data/fineweb_4096_packed_full,/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/preprocessed_data/capability_mixture_4096_packed; OUT=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/birwkv_sampler_eval0; mkdir -p $OUT; pids=; for g in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$g python -m eval.capability.sampler_eval_offline --ckpt_dir $CKPT --model_dir $MDIR --token_dirs $TDIRS --per_dir 256 --window 1024 --batch 16 --self_correction --shard $g --num_shards 8 --output $OUT/sampler.shard${g}of8.json > $OUT/gpu$g.log 2>&1 & pids="$pids $!"; done; rc=0; for p in $pids; do wait $p || rc=$?; done; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then python -m eval.capability.merge_eval --shards-glob "$OUT/sampler.shard*of8.json" --output-dir $OUT/merged --bootstrap-samples 1000; fi; exit $rc'
description: Offline larger-batch sampler eval on the 2.9B conversion checkpoint (step_00004000): settles the code/plan 4.6 iterative-beats-single-step gate with real sample sizes. 512 held-out sequences (256 fineweb tail + 256 capability-mixture tail), grid mask_ratio {0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9} x steps {1,8,16,32,64}, self-correction remask ON, 8 GPU shards, bootstrap-CI merge per arm. The in-loop training eval used only 2 sequences and oscillated; this is the definitive measurement.
